name: CreateContact
label: Create Salesforce Contact
description: Creates a new Contact record in Salesforce using the provided credentials and contact details.

fields.name: Credential
fields.label: Credential to Connect With
fields.description: The Salesforce connection credential to use for authentication.

fields.name: FirstName
fields.label: First Name
fields.description: The first name of the Contact (required).

fields.name: LastName
fields.label: Last Name
fields.description: The last name of the Contact (required).

fields.name: AdditionalFields
fields.label: Additional Fields
fields.description: Optional additional fields such as Email, Phone, Title, etc.

fields.name: ContactId
fields.label: Created Contact ID
fields.description: The Salesforce ID of the newly created Contact record.

fields.name: Response
fields.label: Response
fields.description: The raw JSON response returned by Salesforce after creating the Contact.
